page.title: Chestburster
page.meta_description: The chestburster is the newborn xenomorph that erupts from a host's chest — Alien's most copied shock. Related pages: Xenomorph, Facehugger.
page.content:
Infant xenomorph that kills its host on the way out.

How Chestburster connects

  • Concept: Xenomorph — The chestburster is the xenomorph's birth from a host.
  • Concept: Facehugger — A facehugger implantation produces a chestburster.
